explanation: He gathered about 114,000 quotations, from writers such as Shakespeare, Milton and Dryden, to illustrate some 42,000 entries. The Oxford English Dictionary later built on the same idea.
learnMore: A Dictionary of the English Language

claims.text: Samuel Johnson's 1755 Dictionary of the English Language illustrated how words were used with quotations from published writers.
Johnson's Dictionary did not show usage with drawings, Latin translations or rhyming examples.
Johnson quoted writers such as Shakespeare, Milton and Dryden.
The Oxford English Dictionary later used quotations to illustrate usage on a much larger scale.
